name: unipaper-bridge
description: Research papers autonomously, expand citation networks when coverage matters, try lawful open access first, use local institutional access only when needed, and preserve important sources in Zotero with user consent.

interface.shortDescription: Research, library access, and Zotero capture
interface.longDescription: Runs the normal scholarly research workflow, performs bounded one-hop expansion into earlier, later, and similar papers when coverage matters, verifies whether full text is actually readable, automatically opens the isolated local KHU browser only as a last-mile fallback, and saves material sources to the user's local Zotero library after opt-in. It never returns university credentials, cookies, sessions, or licensed full text through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Research this paper, expand important citation networks when coverage matters, use my configured university access only if lawful public full text is unavailable, and save material sources to Zotero when authorised.
이 주제의 핵심 논문과 중요한 선행·후속·유사 연구를 조사하고, 원문을 못 읽을 때만 설정된 경희대 로컬 접속을 사용하며, 허용된 경우 중요한 원문을 Zotero에 저장해줘.
